rooms.label: 📋 Bookings by Date
rooms.intro: All YA Cell room bookings for one date. Pick a date above. ❄️ marks rooms that need the aircon remote. “Unassigned” means the room is reserved for YA but no cell has been given it yet.

cells.label: 🏠 Cell Bookings
cells.intro: Find your cell group to see its upcoming room bookings. Tap a booking for key, aircon remote and instrument collection details.

custom.label: 📌 Notes
custom.content:
Write anything leaders should know here: announcements, contacts, room rules.

Use *asterisks* for bold. Links like https://example.com become clickable.

celllist.label: 🗂️ Bookings by Cell Group
celllist.intro: Every cell’s upcoming dates and rooms. Tap 📋 Copy for a WhatsApp-ready summary of one cell, or Copy All for every cell. Rooms with no cell yet are grouped under Unassigned.

wagen.label: 💬 Send Reminder
wagen.intro: Ready-to-send WhatsApp reminders for each cell on the chosen date, with key, AV guide and return instructions. Rooms that need the aircon remote use Template 2. Tap 📋 Copy and paste it into the cell’s chat.

newcomers.label: 👥 Newcomers
newcomers.intro: Load your newcomer list (CSV) to sort and filter by last contact. Last-contacted dates in amber are 31–60 days ago, and red means 60+ days. The file stays on your device and isn’t uploaded or shared.

collection.key: 🔑 *Key*: collect/return at guard post (level 4). Can collect from 5pm onwards.
collection.aircon: ❄️ *Aircon remote*: collect/return at guard post (level 4). Please switch off all aircons.
collection.signage: 🪧 *CG signage*: return to guard post (level 4) together with the keys.
